ol.li: Open the lid of the by pressing the lid release button.
Fill with fresh water between the MIN and MAX markings.
Close the lid until it clicks into place.
Place the kettle on the power base.
Press the ON/OFF switch. The power indicator will illuminate.
The will automatically switch off when the water boils.

section.title: Care and Maintenance
section.p: To descale the , fill with equal parts water and white vinegar. Boil, then let stand for one hour. Rinse thoroughly.
Wipe the exterior with a damp cloth. Never use abrasive cleaners.
